name: AR_REVENUE_ADJUSTMENTS_ALL
description: The AR_REVENUE_ADJUSTMENTS_ALL table stores all information about revenue adjustments on transactions for on-line query, audit, and reporting. The primary key for this table is REVENUE_ADJUSTMENT_ID.

columns.name: REVENUE_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Unique ID for revenue adjustment

columns.name: REVENUE_ADJUSTMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Unique reference number for revenue adjustment

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_ID
columns.description: ID of revenue adjusted transaction

columns.name: APPLICATION_DATE
columns.description: Date when revenue adjustment was applied

columns.name: AMOUNT_MODE
columns.description: Indicates type of amount that is adjusted

columns.name: AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount of revenue that is adjusted, in transaction currency

columns.name: PERCENT
columns.description: Percentage of revenue that is adjusted

columns.name: LINE_SELECTION_MODE
columns.description: Indicates criterion that is used to select lines

columns.name: FROM_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: ID of category that revenue is adjusted from

columns.name: TO_CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: ID of category that revenue is transferred to

columns.name: FROM_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: ID of inventory item that revenue is adjusted from

columns.name: TO_INVENTORY_ITEM_ID
columns.description: ID of inventory item that revenue is transferred to

columns.name: FROM_CUST_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: ID of transaction line that revenue is adjusted from

columns.name: TO_CUST_TRX_LINE_ID
columns.description: ID of transaction line that revenue is transferred to

columns.name: GL_DATE
columns.description: Default GL date for the revenue adjustment accounting

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Indicates the type of revenue adjustment

columns.name: REASON_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the reason for the revenue adjustment

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Further information to supplement revenue adjustment reason (free text)

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Indicates revenue adjustment status
